description: Age-stratified test: does the fibro-inflammatory signature accumulate with age as the canonical cumulative-injury model predicts?
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, re, json
from scipy import stats
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

MX="GSE6011_series_matrix.txt.gz"; AN="GPL96.annot.gz"
lines=pd.read_csv(MX, compression="gzip", sep="\x01", header=None, nrows=80, dtype=str, quoting=3, engine="python")[0].tolist()
def field(n):
    for l in lines:
        if l.startswith(n+"\t"): return [x.strip('"') for x in l.split("\t")[1:]]
    return []
chars=[l for l in lines if l.startswith("!Sample_characteristics_ch1")]
S=pd.DataFrame(dict(acc=field("!Sample_geo_accession"), src=field("!Sample_source_name_ch1"),
                    age=[float(re.search(r"([\d.]+)",x).group(1)) for x in chars[1].split("\t")[1:]]))
S["group"]=np.where(S.src.str.contains("normal|control",case=False),"CTRL","DMD")
ahdr=pd.read_csv(AN, compression="gzip", sep="\x01", header=None, nrows=40, dtype=str, quoting=3, engine="python")[0].tolist()
skip=[i for i,l in enumerate(ahdr) if l.startswith("ID\t")][0]
ann=pd.read_csv(AN, sep="\t", compression="gzip", skiprows=skip, dtype=str, quoting=3, on_bad_lines="skip")
sym=dict(zip(ann.ID, ann["Gene symbol"]))
expr=pd.read_csv(MX, sep="\t", compression="gzip", comment="!", index_col=0, quoting=3).dropna(how="all")
expr.index=[str(i).strip('"') for i in expr.index]; expr.columns=[c.strip('"') for c in expr.columns]
expr["sym"]=[sym.get(i) for i in expr.index]; expr=expr[expr.sym.notna()&(expr.sym!="")]
E=expr.groupby("sym").max(); S=S.set_index("acc").reindex([c for c in E.columns])
X=E.astype(float)

MOD={"Fibrosis / ECM":["COL1A1","COL1A2","COL3A1","COL5A1","COL5A2","COL6A3","FN1","LUM","POSTN","TGFB1","CTGF","SPARC","BGN","FBN1","TIMP1"],
     "Inflammation / myeloid":["SPP1","CD68","CD14","TYROBP","C1QA","C1QB","C1QC","CCL2","TNF","IL1B","LGALS3","FCGR3A","AIF1","PTPRC"],
     "Regeneration / immature myofiber":["MYH3","MYH8","MYOG","MYF5","MYF6","PAX7","NCAM1","TNNT2","IGF2","MEST","DLK1","CDKN1A"],
     "Membrane repair":["DYSF","TRIM72","ANXA1","ANXA2","ANXA6","MYOF","CAV3","S100A10"]}
# z-score each gene across all samples, then average within module -> per-sample module score
Z=X.sub(X.mean(1),axis=0).div(X.std(1).replace(0,np.nan),axis=0)
SC=pd.DataFrame({m: Z.loc[[g for g in gl if g in Z.index]].mean() for m,gl in MOD.items()})
SC["DMD_expr"]=X.loc["DMD"]; SC["age"]=S.age.values; SC["group"]=S.group.values

print("=== Per-sample module scores vs age within DMD cases (Spearman) ===")
d=SC[SC.group=="DMD"]; c=SC[SC.group=="CTRL"]
rows=[]
for m in list(MOD)+["DMD_expr"]:
    rho,pv=stats.spearmanr(d.age, d[m])
    # youngest DMD (pre-ambulatory, <= 9 months) vs ALL controls
    yo=d[d.age<=9][m]; ct=c[m]
    U,pu=stats.mannwhitneyu(yo,ct)
    sd=np.sqrt((yo.var(ddof=1)+ct.var(ddof=1))/2); dd=(yo.mean()-ct.mean())/sd
    rows.append(dict(module=m, n_young=len(yo), rho_age_in_DMD=rho, p_age=pv,
                     d_young_vs_ctrl=dd, p_young=pu))
T=pd.DataFrame(rows); print(T.to_string(index=False,float_format=lambda x:f"{x:.3g}"))
T.to_csv("GSE6011_age_stratified_module_scores.csv",index=False)
print("\nyoungest DMD ages (mo):", sorted(d[d.age<=9].age.tolist()))
print("control ages (mo):", sorted(c.age.tolist()))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15.5,4.8))
for ax,m in zip(axes, ["Fibrosis / ECM","Inflammation / myeloid","Regeneration / immature myofiber"]):
    ax.scatter(c.age, c[m], c="#4C72B0", s=42, label="control", edgecolor="k", lw=.4)
    ax.scatter(d.age, d[m], c="#C44E52", s=42, label="DMD", edgecolor="k", lw=.4)
    rho,pv=stats.spearmanr(d.age,d[m])
    ax.set_xscale("log"); ax.set_xlabel("age at biopsy, months (log scale)")
    ax.set_ylabel("module z-score"); ax.set_title(f"{m}\nwithin-DMD age rho={rho:.2f}, p={pv:.2f}", fontsize=10)
    ax.axhline(0,color="grey",lw=.6,ls=":"); ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower right")
plt.suptitle("Fibro-inflammatory and regenerative transcription is already maximal in the youngest, pre-ambulatory DMD infants and does not rise with age (GSE6011)", fontsize=10.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
